messages:
Marta: spotting ~30% warmpool join failures in us-west-2 since 03:05 UTC. Nodes failing disk unlock due to ephemeral keystore timeouts, then hitting the egress-throttle gate (penaltybox).
Devon: Which deploy changed the gate?
Marta: Keystore-proxy rollout 03:00 UTC introduced egress-throttle gate at 110 qps/az. Audit backfill plus exporter burst pushed us past it.
Hiro: Logs show dial i/o timeouts, not 5xx. Snippet:
```
2026-04-02T03:06:12Z keystore-proxy: dial tcp 10.0.12.9:443: i/o timeout
2026-04-02T03:06:13Z egress-gate: enter penaltybox keystore-usw2-aza
```
Aisha: consequence = unable to fetch ephemeral keys -> disk stays encrypted -> join fails. Warmpool hosts should degrade, not be evicted.
Devon: Quick options: 1) scale NAT egress capacity (fast but costs) 2) flip audit-shipper to local-cache mode (--audit-local-cache=true) to cut keystore QPS 3) relax gate threshold to 220 qps temporarily.
Marta: I can flip audit-local-cache as a canary 5% now, needs Devon ack.
Devon: ack. Do 5% canary, monitor disk-unlock success and keystore qps.
Ops-bot: canary deploy started by Marta at 03:18 UTC (5% audit-local-cache)
Marta: canary reduced keystore calls ~92% for canary hosts, disk-unlock success returned to baseline. Gate no longer active for canary nodes.
Hiro: cost math: NAT scale for 2h ~= $1.8k. Local-cache is zero-cost. Relaxing gate risks other services; avoid unless necessary.
Devon: good outcome. Follow-ups: (a) add metric egress.gate.penaltybox.count (b) change warmpool policy: keystore timeouts -> mark degraded, do not evict (ticket INFRA-9222) (c) add a scoped whitelist for exporter to reduce bursts.
Marta: PR for audit-local-cache toggle: https://git.redwood/infra/audit-shipper/pull/210 - will merge after one review.
Aisha: update runbook "egress-throttle gate" with local-cache canary steps + cost thresholds.
Marta: resolving thread once PR merged and 12h stable. Thanks :thumbsup:
